title: Fushimi Inari, up to Yotsutsuji
content:
Fushimi Inari Taisha, the head shrine of Inari, and the paths of vermilion torii that climb Mount Inari behind it. The Rōmon gate stands at the entrance; fox statues, Inari's messengers, are all over the mountain. Yotsutsuji crossing, about halfway up, looks out over south Kyoto.

Demo day: the walk is a simulated route along the real paths. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
